decisions.reason: As an adjacent product in the core construction range, it likely meets a modest aspiration level through fit with existing customers, service and parts capabilities, so management would usually retain it absent clear signs of underperformance.

Because this rescue vehicle is more distant from the established offer and still lacks visible market validation, it remains under closer aspiration-based scrutiny, but long niche sales cycles and available organisational slack still justify continued trial for now.

A multi-model telescopic loader line deepens the core portfolio and creates strong cross-selling and service synergies, so results would have to fall well below aspiration before a withdrawal became likely.
The reported major order and claim of strong rental popularity indicate performance above aspiration for a closely related product line, making withdrawal within a year very unlikely.

Although more distant from the established offer, the early evidence of intensive real-world use suggests the product is meeting or exceeding aspirations, so management would normally keep it while monitoring further market acceptance.
